Research Internship Company Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed Type Internship Location Delft (NL), Amersfoort Sector Heritage, Urbanism Required language Dutch, English Website https://www.cultureelerfgoed.nl/ Description 
Within the Post+65 programme of the Cultural Heritage Agency of the Netherlands (RCE), we are looking for an intern for a research project on inner-city transformations in the Netherlands between 1950 and 2020. This is a paid internship. 
As an intern, you will contribute to historical (archival) research and cartographic reconstructions of inner cities, combining this with GIS, spatial data and historical maps. You will be part of a project team and help map how inner cities have changed over time. 
What will you do? - Archival research into inner-city developments - Cartographic reconstruction of inner cities using GIS - Working with spatial data and historical maps - Collaborating within a project team 
What are we looking for? - Some experience with GIS - Preferably Dutch-speaking - Able to work independently - Interest in spatial transformations and heritage 
The work can be carried out from Delft, but you are also very welcome at the RCE in Amersfoort. 
Interested? 
Contact Yvonne van Mil at y.b.c.vanmil@tudelft.nl for more information or to apply.

Full-time (36-40 hours) · Drachten, the Netherlands 
Kavel 10 is an aerial survey company operating across Western Europe. We fly our own aircraft with our own camera and LiDAR systems, and process all data in-house. In addition to project work for clients, we run our own nationwide aerial imagery programme for the Netherlands. 
To strengthen our processing team, we are looking for an experienced photogrammetry specialist who can take ownership of large, technically demanding production projects. 
 What will you do? 
You will be responsible for processing aerial imagery into high-quality photogrammetric products, from raw data to final delivery.

You will work on: - Processing projects end to end in specific photogrammetric software: raw data processing, radiometric corrections, aerotriangulation, DSM extraction, true ortho and classic ortho production; - Our yearly nationwide program of the Netherlands, as well as client projects in the Netherlands and abroad; - Quality control on accuracy, radiometry and mosaicking; - Translating tender and client specifications into a processing plan and final deliverables; - Automating and optimising the processing workflow; - Documenting and standardising processes. 
 Who are we looking for? 
We are looking for someone who is technically strong, works independently and likes to take ownership of complex projects.
